Light Novel 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu' Concludes with 10th Volume
The official X account for author Nana Mikoshiba announced on Tuesday that the Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu: Sekai Saikyou no Majutsushi de Aru Shounen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ni Nyuugaku suru (The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World) light novel series will end with its tenth volume, scheduled to be released on December 2. Web Manga 'Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai' Gets TV Anime in 2027
Publishing company Manga Box announced a television anime adaptation of Izumi and Mitsuya Otosu's Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai (My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending) web manga on Tuesday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured above). Otosu also drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured right). The anime series will premiere in 2027. 'Ghost: Yoru no Hate' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Song, Main Trailer
The official website for the Ghost: Yoru no Hate original anime movie unveiled additional cast, staff, a second key visual (pictured right), the theme song, and main trailer on Tuesday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on February 11, 2027. The movie was previewed at Sitges Film Festival on October 9 and at Animation Is Film Festival on October 17.
